command: python -m lakehouse.maintenance compact --days 3 (Trino ALTER TABLE ... EXECUTE optimize(file_size_threshold => '64MB'))
note: Values copied verbatim from the command output. Query latency = median-of-4 client wall time for SELECT agent_version, approx_percentile(duration_ms, 0.95) FROM agent_spans GROUP BY 1.
interpretation: File count fell from 206 to 64. No latency improvement was measured at this data size (difference within run-to-run noise; fewer, larger files also mean fewer parallel splits on single-node Trino). The benefit of compaction grows with file count and data size; it is reported here as measured, not assumed.
